$comment: The fleet, written down. Copy the object into Render's FLEET_ROSTER variable, or save this file as fleet/roster.json and commit it — the environment wins when both exist. Nothing here is secret: a Device ID is public and a wallet is an address. Every field except the ID is optional, and an entry that sets nothing still enrols the rig so commands can reach it.

ZMR-1111-2222-3333.label: one that only needs to be reachable
